description: This source file defines the ContentPagesController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing content pages within an admin interface. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving details, deleting, and saving content pages, as well as checking for unique content codes. The controller interacts with ContentService and LanguageService to manage content data and handles HTTP requests mapped to specific URLs related to content page management.

classes.name: ContentPagesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing content page operations such as listing, creation, retrieval, deletion, and validation within an admin interface.

methods.name: listContentPages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list content pages, setting up the menu and returning the content pages view.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize creation of a new content page, pre-populating descriptions for all store languages.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific content page by ID for viewing or editing, validating ownership and content type.

methods.name: removeContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a content page by ID, returning JSON response status.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of content items of a specified type (PAGE or BOX) for the store and language.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a content page, setting its type and associating descriptions with the correct language.

methods.name: checkContentCode
methods.description: Validates whether a content code is unique within the store, used for client-side validation.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu attributes in the model for UI navigation purposes.
